app.title: Agents dashboard
app.name: Agents dashboard
mute.title: System notifications
hdr.clear.title: Hides older events on screen; the event file is not changed
hdr.theme.title: Theme
kpi.errors.some: failures present, see the Events tab
kpi.limit.nodata: data will appear from the status line
zoom.in.title: Zoom in (Ctrl+wheel)
lim.empty: Limits appear once an active session updates the status line (Pro/Max subscription required); for now only token accounting is shown.
us.note: Limits are based on weighted usage, so token counts are approximate: cache reads cost far less than output.
us.nosess: No active sessions with a status line
md.sess.hint: The /model command is typed into the terminal via tmux when the session is idle.
md.def.hint: Changes the model key in ~/.claude/settings.json (a backup is kept).
md.agents.hint: Changes the model: line in ~/.claude/agents/<agent>.md (a backup is kept); applies to new agent runs.
md.sess_ok: The /model {m} command was typed into the terminal
md.confirm: Change the default model in ~/.claude/settings.json to "{m}"? Applies to new sessions.
agents.hint: click a row to open the agent
chat.empty: The conversation will appear here: your commands (terminal, Telegram, dashboard) and Claude’s replies.
chat.reuse: Click to paste into the field
cmd.delivery.title: tmux types the command into the terminal immediately, even when the session is idle (only if the session was started via claude-tmux)
cmd.waiting: Session is idle: the command ({n}) will run as soon as the session receives its next prompt or step
cmd.queued_why: Added to the queue ({why}, tmux skipped)
ev.empty: No events: they appear when agents or the session run tools
plan.empty: No steps yet. The orchestrator adds them via log.sh
err.pick_to: Choose a session in the "To" list
err.no_pane: session is not in tmux or its pane is closed
err.busy_turn: session is busy: wait for the turn to finish
err.dialog: a dialog is open in the terminal
sx.tokens.split: tokens: {n} (output {out}, input {in}, cache write {cc}, cache read {cr})
sx.edge.title: {from} → {to} · {kind}{label} · handoffs in window: {n}
sx.notok: Per-agent tokens unavailable: no subagent transcript data for this period.
sx.tokwin: Tokens are kept for the last {d} days only (all time is limited to that period).
agents.showall.aria: Show all agents, including inactive ones
sx.aria: Active agents laid out left to right by stage
sx.card.aria: {name}: {runs} runs, {calls} calls, {tokens}, state: {state}. Press Enter to open the agent panel
sx.empty.title: No active agents
sx.empty.sub: No agent was launched in the selected period ({w}). As soon as the orchestrator calls one, it appears here as a large card; the rest of the team is listed below.
sx.orch.desc: Main session: takes the task, routes it between team agents and reports back to the user.
sx.legend: Line thickness = number of handoffs (next agent started in the same session ≤30 min after the previous one finished) · blue dashes = running now · fine dots = link through an inactive agent · amber dashes = returned for rework
sx.rest.title: Inactive in the selected window: {n}
sx.rest.hint: hover for a tooltip, click to open the agent panel
sx.all.title: All agents: {n}
sx.all.hint: hover or select an agent to see incoming (←) and outgoing (→) links
sx.chip.aria: inactive in this window, open panel
office.aria: Isometric 3D office: group rooms and agents
office.canvas.aria: 3D office scene. Drag to orbit, wheel to zoom. The same content is in the list next to it.
office.nogl: WebGL is not available in this browser — use the agent list next to it.
office.loaderr: Could not load the 3D scene — use the agent list.
office.legend: Drag to orbit · wheel to zoom · Shift+drag to pan · click a room or an agent for details
now.title: Now
now.none: No agent is running right now. Once an agent starts, it will show up here with its run time.
now.bars.aria: Tool calls per minute, last 15 minutes
an.title: Event analytics
an.empty.title: No data for analytics yet
an.empty.sub: There are no events in the "{w}" window. Pick a wider window above or run an agent — metrics will appear on their own.
an.empty.part: Not enough data in this window.
an.fine.err: Share of PostToolUse events with an error among all of the agent's finished calls.
an.fine.dur: From SubagentStart to SubagentStop; bars show average, maximum and run count.
an.fine.heat: Top 8 agents by calls; a brighter cell means more calls.
an.err.nopost: No finished calls in this window.
an.dur.none: No finished runs in this window (start and stop events are required).
